title: Patenting Healthcare-related Inventions: A Guide for IP advisers and managers
content: Patenting Healthcare-related Inventions provides a reference document for essential stakeholders involved in patenting innovation within the life sciences sector, particularly within the technical fields of biotechnology and pharmaceuticals.
